info.title: Messenger Platform API (Meta Graph API)
info.description: Meta's Messenger Platform, served over the Graph API at graph.facebook.com: the Send API, attachment upload, Messenger profile and per-user settings, personas, custom/thread labels, conversation routing (handover), conversations and messages, moderation, page status and feature review, calling, user profile and messaging insights. The OpenFn facebook adaptor's postMessage() POSTs a Send API request to /v2.6/me/messages.

version.description: Graph API version; the adaptor hard-codes v2.6.

post.description: Send API. The adaptor's postMessage() calls POST /me/messages (with a Page access token `me` is the Page) with messaging_type UPDATE. Also used for sender actions (typing_on/off, mark_seen).

parameters.description: This is the maximum number of objects that may be returned. A query may return fewer than the value of limit due to filtering. Do not depend on the number of results being fewer than the limit value to indicate that your query reached the end of the list of data, use the absence of next instead. For example, if you set limit to 10 and 9 results are returned, there may be more data available, but one item was removed due to privacy filtering. In all cases, the API returns the correct pagination links.
